## ENSHROUDED — Nexus Mods (thin/early ecosystem)
Maturity note: ecosystem is thin and early. Two competing loaders — Shroudtopia and EML (Experimental Mod Loader) — plus the standalone Enshrouded Patcher; most content is QoL tweaks and a Cheat Engine table rather than deep content mods. Managers exist but the scene is small. (EML's own Nexus page ID was not verifiable via search, so it is represented through the Shroudtopia Manager which installs both loaders.)

Notes for the manager build:
- Thunderstore `source_id` uses the canonical `Author-PackageName` form (directly resolvable to `thunderstore.io/c/<game>/p/Author/PackageName/`); Nexus `source_id` is the numeric mod ID (`nexusmods.com/<game>/mods/<id>`).
- Popularity is qualitative (very-high/high/medium/niche), derived from Thunderstore most-downloaded ordering and Nexus top rankings, not live counts.
- Valheim/V Rising entries were cross-checked against Thunderstore most-downloaded listings; `r2modman` and `PalModManager`/`Shroudtopia Manager` are themselves managers — flag them so your own one-click manager doesn't offer to install a competing manager.
